title: Locale-prioritized embedding-aware rerank fallback architecture
creator: Sofia Patel
description: Design and implement a fallback architecture for the reranking endpoint that uses embedding-derived candidate profiles and locale-prioritized model selection to meet tight latency SLOs while preserving quality across long-tail languages.
acceptance_criteria: Endpoint selects compact cross-encoder variant for locales with strict 50ms p95 latency targets and escalates to higher-capacity models only when quality delta exceeds threshold
Automatic prefix caching heater warms candidate KV for top 10% high-traffic locales within 2 minutes of traffic pattern shift
Canary rollout mechanism validates no >1% quality regression on held-out multilingual eval sets and no >10% increase in p95 latency for affected routes
Observability shows per-locale token cost delta, p50/p95 latency, and correctness delta in Console within rollout window
technical_notes: Introduce a lightweight candidate profile computed from embeddings: token-length distribution, average top-k similarity, and locale affinity score
Model-selection policy implemented as a routing function in the runtime: {policy: 'locale_affinity', budget_ms: 50, quality_threshold: 0.04} (policy values are stored in config and feature flagged)
Compact cross-encoder binary will be quantized with 8-bit kernels and curated KV cache warm-start heuristics to reduce cold-start latency
Fallback orchestration will prefer GPU pool with cached KV; if capacity constrained switch to async batch path with best-effort latency hints
Integration points: Console rollout API, Optimize suggestions for quantization profile, and tracing hooks for per-token breakdown
rollout_plan: Stage 0: Local dev and unit tests (feature branch)
Stage 1: Internal shadow testing against production traffic for 48h (no serving) with quality logs
Stage 2: Canary to 1% of traffic for low-risk locales (EN/ES) with automatic rollback on regression criteria
Stage 3: Gradual ramp to 20% over 72h, expand to long-tail locales with dedicated KV warmers
Stage 4: Full rollout with post-rollout 7-day monitoring and cost verification
metrics: Quality: pairwise win-rate vs baseline reranker, per-locale NDCG@10 delta
Latency: p50/p95 per-route and per-locale, cold-start 95th for new candidate pools
Cost: tokens-per-request and GPU-seconds per 1k requests, delta vs baseline
Reliability: error rate and fallback invocation rate
test_plan: Automated unit tests for candidate-profile generation and routing logic
Regression harness: multilingual eval sets (60 locales) run on every candidate change
Load test: simulate 10k rps with KV warm/cold scenarios to validate autoscaling and batch-backfill behavior
Manual QA: smoke checks for top-5 customers using rerank API (coordinated with CS)
